profile.subtitleJa: 父ウジヤの治世の末期に王宮を管理し、国民を裁いた人物です。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下26:21は、ウジヤが隔離された後、ヨタムが王宮を管理し、国の民を裁いたと記します。

facts.textJa: ウジヤの死後、ヨタムが父の後を継いだと記されています。
ヨタムは25歳で王となり、エルサレムで16年間治めたと記されます。母はザドクの娘エルシャです。
ヨタムが主の前に歩んだため強くなったと記されます。
ヨタムのほかの行い、戦い、歩みはイスラエルとユダの王の記録にあると記されます。
ヨタムの死後、子アハズが王位を継いだと記されます。

wikipedia.title: Jotham (king of Judah)
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、ユダの王ヨタムを扱い、ウジヤの子であることを説明しています。この紹介は、ヨタムが王として即位した後の記述に対応します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the LORD’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
